what: The op census of the routing brick (`ops.moe_route.moe_route`, one kernel `moe_route_kernel`): the Triton primitives its kernel uses, the lowering each backend gives them, the callers and the keys a card certifies. A key is (E, H, top_k, the hidden and router weight dtypes, then float32 bias, int64 indices, float32 weights: `launch_keys.moe_route_launches`); B, T, n_group and the gate and selection attributes are not in it (one program per token row: the token step and the prefill, every variant of one geometry, share one configuration). `primitives` and `dtypes` are checked against the kernel's source by a test. A cell is certified only by the certification commands below on a named card: its `proof` then names the card, the commit, the date and the result file.
control: for over range() with 32-bit bounds (H tiles, groups, kept groups, top_k)
if on constexpr flags (SIGMOID, HAS_BIAS, GROUPED, GROUP_TOP2, RENORM)
integer // and % on the 64-bit row index (batch and token of the row)
.to() casts: operands to float32, indices to int64
not_used: no tl.dot (the router product is a broadcast multiply reduced by tl.sum: no matrix unit on any backend), no atomic, no barrier, no shared-memory staging written by hand

cuda.notes: tl.exp lowers to the fast exp2 path; the reduction order of tl.sum and tl.max follows num_warps
cuda.certification: NEEDS CARD: the Dell's V100 pool, command `dell` below

metal.lowering: triton-ext's AppleGPU backend (the library's Metal Triton)
metal.notes: every loop bound is 32-bit (the lowering refuses a 64-bit scf.for bound); bfloat16 runs only where the device has it natively (the device test skips it otherwise)
metal.certification: NEEDS CARD: the Mac, command `mac` below

cpu.lowering: Triton's interpreter (numpy) on this repository's host test; triton-cpu is not certified
cpu.notes: the interpreter test runs every gate x selection pair at T 1, 2, 23 and [2, 23], float32 and bfloat16, against the plain reference
cpu.certification: none: the interpreter has no timer; the host test is a correctness proof, not a configuration

callers.caller: nbxtensor: any op of the library
callers.dimensions: none: the routing stays outside the dispatch (ops/dispatch.py) and reaches fused_moe through its precomputed-routing entry
none yet: the engine's MoE fusion calls moe_route nowhere (the matcher of the grouped sigmoid router is the engine half of this brick)

callers.caller: a recorded grouped sigmoid router (task 824's proof: sigmoid + bias, grouped top-k over [T, 1, 64], top-k 4)
callers.calls: moe_route once a MoE layer a step: T = 1 for a generated token, T = the prompt for a prefill

dimensions.H: the router weight's, read from the container at the build

certification.keys: python tools/moe_route_certification_keys.py --out moe_route_keys.txt   (one '<kernel>::<key>' line a cell; --dtypes float32,float16 to leave bfloat16 out)
certification.dell: python tools/moe_route_certification_keys.py --out moe_route_keys.txt && neurobrix autotune certify --profile volta --vendor nvidia --keys moe_route_keys.txt && NBX_AUTOTUNE_CERTIFIED_ONLY=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_one_token_of_the_moe_route_on_a_device_is_its_oracle.py tests/test_a_key_the_card_has_not_certified_is_refused_by_name_never_swept_for_the_moe_route.py
certification.mac: python tools/moe_route_certification_keys.py --out moe_route_keys.txt && neurobrix autotune certify --profile apple_m4_pro --vendor apple --keys moe_route_keys.txt && NBX_AUTOTUNE_CERTIFIED_ONLY=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_one_token_of_the_moe_route_on_a_device_is_its_oracle.py tests/test_a_key_the_card_has_not_certified_is_refused_by_name_never_swept_for_the_moe_route.py
